verdict.rationale: Saved templates are a fair question for an email-sending API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions snippets, templates or variable substitution. Drafts and attachments are documented, but these are adjacent features: a draft is a one-off message awaiting review, not a reusable template with variables.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
